one_liner: Bo Bichette had 917 rows with recorded exit velocity from 2,224 pitches seen -- the highest ratio of recorded exit-velocity rows to pitches among the hitters covered here.
three_things: 917 rows with recorded exit velocity from 2,224 pitches seen.
The contact grades well too -- .349 estimated wOBA at 84.7 mph average.
The 90th-percentile exit velocity, 103 mph, is solid rather than elite.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). Exit-velocity figures use rows with recorded exit velocity. Estimated wOBA on contact uses rows with recorded model estimates, whose count is not reported here, and is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. The comparison of recorded exit-velocity rows to pitches is scoped to the hitters with insight files in this set and is derived from two manifest fields rather than read from one.
